programmes.d: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.
Crichton must infiltrate a Peacekeeper base to save Aeryn's life, but ends up facing torture in an alien electric chair and archenemy Crais.
Talyn gets the urge to fly into a sun. While in its vicinity Stark is contacted by an alien woman who is being held against her will.
The crew of the Moya tries to save Crichton from the hands of Crais and the Peacekeepers; with Gigi Edgley and Wayne Pygram.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E13 - Scratch 'N Sniff
programmes.d: Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana are forced to take a holiday by Pilot as he is fed up with their constant bickering.
Moya and her unsuspecting crew encounter a carnivorous alien.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E14 - Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programmes.d: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E15 - Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programmes.d: Jack (The Ancient) unlocks the wormhole knowledge in Crichton's mind so together they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

With death approaching in the form of Peacekeeper search parties, those aboard Moya say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before enacting a plan to save Moya and her baby, named Talyn.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E16 - Revenging Angel
programmes.d: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world. It's Farscape, Chuck Jones/Loony Tunes style.
Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them; their safety depends on Crais, who is nearby in Talyn.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E17 - The Choice
programmes.d: Aeryn is devastated. She leaves Talyn, and grieves on a planet. Talyn's crew tries to help but she doesn't want their help.

D'Argo takes part in a sacred ritual that helps an old Luxan, an Orican, to survive; during the ritual the Orican draws energy from who she thinks is D'Argo but is actually Moya; consequently Moya starts to age rapidly.
A group of escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have finally returned from Talyn.
Chiana joins a group of nihilistic teenagers on a cemetery planet.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E19 - I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programmes.d: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.
An alien boards Moya, deranging the crew.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E20 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programmes.d: The crew must stop Scorpius's research on wormhole technology. The only way to stop him is to board the command carrier.
Chiana discovers a recording with Moya's original Pilot; after seeing the recording and realizing Aeryn was involved, Pilot orders Aeryn to leave Moya.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E21 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programmes.d: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.
A fortunetelling portrait acquired from a passing trader turns out to be the tool of an old enemy. With Ben Browder.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E22 - Dog With Two Bones
programmes.d: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground where D'Argo is forced to destroy a rogue Leviathan that is attacking other ships.
Crichton and the crew desperately search for food to nurse an ailing friend back to health, but they may have to sacrifice a friend to save one.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E1 - Crichton Kicks
programmes.d: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan named Elac, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.
Zhaan, Chiana and Rygel come to grips with the apparent deaths of Crichton, Aeryn and D'Argo.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E2 - What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programmes.d: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.
After an enemy ship fires on Moya, crew members find that their personalities have been switched. With Ben Browder.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E3 - What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programmes.d: The crew discovers how far Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks.
Contact with a mysterious light source creates three separate Crichtons from different rungs of the evolutionary ladder.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E4 - Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programmes.d: The crew is on the way to rendezvous with Moya. After ingesting a concoction of Noranti's they stop for a break on a planet.
Moya and her crew land on a planet just in time to celebrate the coronation of a new royal couple, but there is a catch -- the princess has not found her prince.
Everyone finally reunites on Moya. But Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims to have saved the former Peacekeeper's life.
A quick turn of events sees Crichton chosen as the unwilling groom-to-be in the upcoming royal wedding.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E6 - Natural Election
programmes.d: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.
Someone removes Crichton's head from a statue; Aeryn examines her choices; Zhaan faces a Moya builder.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E7 - John Quixote
programmes.d: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.
A crew member falls prey to a shape-shifting parasite and the rest of the crew must locate it before it is too late.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E8 - I Shrink Therefore I Am
programmes.d: When Moya is raided by bounty hunters working for the Peacekeepers, every crew member is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.
Crichton becomes a mental slave on a commerce planet and must trust his greatest enemy, Scorpius, to help him see the truth through the illusions.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E9 - A Prefect Murder
programmes.d: While Moya and her crew are resupplying on a generally xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect while under a strange form of suggestion.
The crew races to save Crichton after contact with a hyper stream of time speeds up his aging process.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E10 - Coup By Clam
programmes.d: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. Although if not ingested by the same person, it becomes toxic.
Talyn destroys a Plokavian ship, leading to the capture of the crew.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E11 - Unrealized Reality
programmes.d: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets up with a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.
Chiana's unknowing part in the Nebari scheme to control a portion of the galaxy is revealed after they take over the Moya.
After accidentally returning to Earth, Crichton discovers he is in 1985 and he has altered the timeline.
Stark plans to rob a less-than-reputable bank to get them money for a sizable purchase of slaves, but things don't quite go the way he thinks they will.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E13 - Terra Firma
programmes.d: Crichton has arrived on Earth. Even though the Moya crew relaxes on Earth and are treated as VIPs, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.
Infected currency from the Shadow Depository threatens the crew of the Moya as they decide how best to rescue D'Argo's son.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E14 - Twice Shy
programmes.d: Moya takes on a new passenger, Talikaa. However, Talikaa turns out to be an alien in disguise and is intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.
The crew of the injured Moya must rely on the help of disorganized mercenaries to save Crichton from Scorpius.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E15 - Mental As Anything
programmes.d: The males of the crew undergo some training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes. While D'Argo learns some self-control.
An alien surgeon comes to the aid of Crichton, removing the control chip from his head and healing the Moya.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E16 - Bringing Home The Beacon
programmes.d: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon for Moya which will allow her to appear to be a different ship.
The Moya's crew must quickly recover from their last adventure because Scorpius is up to his old tricks.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E17 - A Constellation Of Doubt
programmes.d: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a television documentary about himself and the aliens.
